import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

from exmekh_lib.core.agents.deep_agent.deep_agent import DeepAgent
from exmekh_lib.core.agents.node import DefaultCapabilities
from exmekh_lib.core.providers.openai_response_tool_mapper import OpenAIResponseToolMapper
from exmekh_lib.interfaces.provider import Provider
from exmekh_lib.tokenizers.qwen import QwenTokenizer
from exmekh_lib.utils.json import serialize_json

from exmekh_agent.exmekh_bridge.agents.sub_agents import SubAgentEventRouter
from exmekh_agent.exmekh_bridge.capabilities.agent_design import build_generic_agent, build_quick_agent
from exmekh_agent.exmekh_bridge.providers.ds4_prompt import render_ds4_qwen_prompt

ROOT=Path.cwd().parent
OUT=ROOT/'build/qwen27-agent-20261029'
class Captured(BaseException):
    pass
class Capture(Provider):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(QwenTokenizer())
        self.request=None
    def call(self, request):
        self.request=request
        raise Captured()
    def call_structured(self, request):
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected structured request before initial turn')
    def get_tools_text(self, tools):
        return serialize_json(OpenAIResponseToolMapper.map_tools(tools)) if tools else ''

def capture(mode):
    if mode=='quick':
        node=build_quick_agent({},'metal-readiness-quick')
    else:
        node,_=build_generic_agent([DefaultCapabilities().capabilities_path],SubAgentEventRouter(None),{},root_name='main',coding_persistent_history=True,agent_context_id='metal-readiness-main')
    provider=Capture()
    agent=DeepAgent(provider,node,OUT)
    try:
        agent.run('Reply with OK.')
    except Captured:
        pass
    request=provider.request
    if request is None:
        raise RuntimeError('No initial request captured')
    messages=[m.message_dump() for m in request.get_messages()]
    tools=OpenAIResponseToolMapper.map_tools(request.get_tools()) if request.get_tools() else []
    (OUT/(mode+'-request.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'messages':messages,'tools':tools,'extra':request.get_extra()},indent=2)+'\n')
    results=[]
    for thinking in (False,True):
        prompt=render_ds4_qwen_prompt(messages,tools,thinking=thinking)
        path=OUT/(mode+('-thinking' if thinking else '-none')+'.txt')
        path.write_text(prompt)
        command=[str(ROOT/'ds4'),'-m',str(ROOT/'gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_S.gguf'),'--dump-tokens','--raw','--prompt-file',str(path)]
        result=subprocess.run(command,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=30,check=True)
        tokens=json.loads(result.stdout.splitlines()[0])
        (path.with_suffix('.tokens.json')).write_text(json.dumps(tokens)+'\n')
        results.append({'mode':mode,'thinking':thinking,'prompt_tokens':len(tokens),'tool_count':len(tools),'contexts':{str(c):{'fits_prompt':len(tokens)<c,'room_for_output':max(c-len(tokens),0)} for c in (512,1024,2048)},'command':command})
    return results
results=capture('generic')+capture('quick')
(OUT/'prompt-budget.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'Production frontend node/request construction; captured before inference; frontend renderer, exact GGUF tokenizer. No inference or tools executed.','results':results},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
